queries.name: Administrators and Accounts
queries.description: Show administrator-to-account associations for all collected roles and statuses; these are not assertions of full tenant control.

queries.name: Users that are Members of Groups
Users with Bypass Status
queries.query:
MATCH p = (u:Duo_User)
WHERE u.status = 'bypass'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
queries.description: Find users whose Duo status is bypass.

queries.name: Unenrolled Users
queries.query:
MATCH p = (u:Duo_User)
WHERE u.is_enrolled = false
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
queries.description: Find users reported by Duo as not enrolled.

queries.name: Applications Accessible by All Users
queries.query:
MATCH p=(u:Duo_User)-[r:Duo_HasAccessTo]->(a:Duo_Application)
WHERE r.access_type = 'all_users'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
queries.description: Show active or bypass users eligible under an application configured for all users; authentication policies and primary credentials still apply.

queries.name: Access Paths to VPN Applications
queries.query:
MATCH p = (u:Duo_User)-[:Duo_MemberOf|Duo_HasAccessTo*1..2]->(a:Duo_Application)
WHERE a.name CONTAINS 'VPN'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
queries.description: Show direct or group-mediated eligibility for applications with VPN in their name; this is not proof of application compromise.
